title: Lilian's Cottage
description:
Cozy One-Bedroom Cottage

Experience comfort in this charming one-bedroom cottage, situated on the edge of beautiful Shelby Park. Located in the heart of East Nashville’s most desirable neighborhood, you’ll be short distance to top-rated bars, restaurants, shopping, golf courses, and miles of Greenbelt trails. Just two miles away from downtown.

The space
The cottage features an outdoor patio space, a fully equipped kitchen, stackable washer and dryer, a comfortable loft bedroom, and a living room with sofa sleeper all designed to provide a relaxing stay.
